spans.content: EQUITY: HEALTH CARE & PHARMACEUTICALS
Another big win for sac-TMT in upcoming ASCO
Encouraging PFS data and positive OS trend reported in PD-L1+ NSCLC setting; maintain Buy with a higher TP
What is new? OptiTROP-Lung05 trial reported strong PFS and OS data

On 22 May before market open, Kelun Biotech announced that its sac-TMT, a TROP-2 ADC, would report OptiTROP-Lung05 outcome in the upcoming 2026 ASCO on 29 May (local time). The clinical trial enrolled 413 NSCLC (PD-L1+) patients and compares sac-TMT combo pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab (1:1).

Analysis suggest: compared to pembrolizumab alone, sac-TMT combo pembrolizumab (1) improved progression-free survival (PFS) significantly (not reached vs 5.7m, HR=0.35, P<0.0001), (2) demonstrated a higher objective response rate (ORR) 70.2% vs 42% and (3) saw a positive overall survival (OS) trend (HR=0.55).
Furthermore, the PD-L1 TPS 1~49% group showed a better PFS HR of 0.28 compared to the TPS>50% group of HR of 0.47, while the nsNSCLC cohort reported PFS HS of 0.28 versus sNSCLC's 0.44.
Our take: a quite encouraging result; maintain Buy and lift TP to HKD544.42

We view this set of data as quite encouraging, as it is the first ADC reported PFS improvement in a phase III trial for PD-L1+ NSCLC patients. Compared to other regimens (ivonescimab, pembrolizumab combo chemo, for example) that reported an HR of around 0.50, this PFS HR set a quite high bar and may change the competitive landscape. Note: this drug is being priority-reviewed by the Chinese regulator for this indication based on this data.

Considering this positive updates, along with the earlier-announced Trofuse-05 outcome (see our report: Quick Note - Kelun Biotech (6990 HK) (Buy) The first global phase III clinical trial meet primary endpoints, ahead of schedule), we lift our FY35F revenue estimates for this drug in China / overseas market from CNY4.6bn/CNY6.5bn to CNY5.8bn/CNY10.5bn, respectively.

We thus lift our DCF-based TP (including an increase in terminal growth from 4% to 4.5%, on a higher sales outlook, and an unchanged WACC of 10.8%) from HKD438.30 to HKD544.42. The stock currently trades at 4.0x FY35F sales of CNY24bn.
The company will host a session on 31 May 10pm(HKT) to discuss this ASCO update.

Company profile

Kelun-Biotech is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 2016, It is one of the pioneers in the development of antibody drug conjugates (ADCs). Kelun-Biotech has accumulated more than ten years of experience in ADC development and has established its own integrated ADC R&D platform, OptiDC. The company has entered into out-license agreements with MSD to develop ADC assets for cancer treatment with upfront and milestone payments totaling up to USD10bn.

Kelun-Biotech priorize its ESG strategy adhering its mission. The Board is responsible for overseeing and guiding ESG initiatives and setting ESG strategies and policies directly. Definition of Nomura Group's equity research rating system and sectors

The rating system is a relative system, indicating expected performance against a specific benchmark identified for each individual stock, subject to limited management discretion. An analyst's target price is an assessment of the current intrinsic fair value of the stock based on an appropriate valuation methodology determined by the analyst. Valuation methodologies include, but are not limited to, discounted cash flow analysis, expected return on equity and multiple analysis. Analysts may also indicate expected absolute upside/downside relative to the stated target price, defined as (target price - current price)/current price.
STOCKS

A rating of 'Buy', indicates that the analyst expects the stock to outperform the Benchmark over the next 12 months. A rating of 'Neutral', indicates that the analyst expects the stock to perform in line with the Benchmark over the next 12 months. A rating of 'Reduce', indicates that the analyst expects the stock to underperform the Benchmark over the next 12 months. A rating of 'Suspended', indicates that the rating, target price and estimates have been suspended temporarily to comply with applicable regulations and/or firm policies. Securities and/or companies that are labelled as 'Not rated' or shown as 'No rating' are not in regular research coverage. Investors should not expect continuing or additional information from Nomura relating to such securities and/or companies. SECTORS

A 'Neutral' stance, indicates that the analyst expects the sector to perform in line with the Benchmark during the next 12 months. A 'Bearish' stance, indicates that the analyst expects the sector to underperform the Benchmark during the next 12 months. Sectors that are labelled as 'Not rated' or shown as 'N/A' are not assigned ratings.
